scope: Actual retained OWNER1 data only; 24 small-vector consistency audits and one preselected retained full-basis mathematical reconstruction. No population-quality aggregation, ranking, new experiment, synthetic fixture, solver, native/model call, or candidate-code import.
limits: Other owners not accessed; no inference about their results.
23 cases lack full basis: their gradients/residuals and optimization are not independently reconstructed.
Stored solver success/status are reports, not independently rerun solver validation.

Floating-point comparisons report exact equality and differences, without arbitrary tolerance. Different reductions/BLAS may change final bits. Declared acceptance is exact feasibility and computed gap in [0,1e-6], not an interval/formal certificate.
Active masks are checked for shape/domain only, not independently validated as solver internals; zero-column identities can be verified from basis only for preselected case.

preselected_full_basis.method: Independent NumPy column placement from retained native centers and already-windowed blocks, observed-prefix clipping; no solver or candidate import. Normalize coefficients by reciprocal scale, sum retained-column contributions, subtract retained PCM/scale, and take per-column inner products.

stored_scale_isolation.description: Using reported normalization_scale isolates norm-reduction differences; not an independent scale verification.
